title: Linear coordinate comparison of frames after arbitrary base change
statement: Let f:T→S be a map of Noetherian schemes and F a rank-r locally free module on S. Let eS and eT be frames for F on V⊆S and tensorPullback(f)(F) on U⊆T. For an arbitrary scheme W and maps j:W→T, a:W→U and g:W→V with a U.ι=j and j f=g V.ι, there exists H∈GL_r(Γ(W,O_W)) such that the target inverse chart pulled along a and followed by the canonical bundle baseChange map equals affineTraceLinearMap(H) followed by the source inverse chart pulled along g. This is solely an equality of scheme maps.

proof.text: Pull the two frames to W using tensor pullback, its free-module comparison and its composition isomorphism. The two resulting free frames belong to the same pulled-back module.
The resulting free-module automorphism and its inverse give inverse matrices on global basis sections. Use the inverse transpose matrix for the inverse-coordinate convention.

Check the chart equality on degree-one symmetric-algebra generators, using the generator normalization of baseChange. Relative Spec and the tower-to-affine-space comparison give the asserted equality. Rank zero uses the empty matrix and empty W uses the same free-module argument.

theorem vectorIntegration_baseChange_coordinates
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] [IsNoetherian T]
    (f : T ⟶ S) (r : ℕ) (F : S.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r]
    (V : S.Opens) (eS : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization S r F V)
    (U : T.Opens)
    (eT : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization T r
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).obj F) U)
    (W : Scheme.{u}) (j : W ⟶ T) (a : W ⟶ U.toScheme) (g : W ⟶ V.toScheme)
    (ha : a ≫ U.ι = j) (hg : j ≫ f = g ≫ V.ι) :
    ∃ H : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin r) Γ(W, ⊤),
      (affineTraceMap a r ≫ vectorIntegrationChart T r
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).obj F) U eT) ≫
          VectorTraceGeometry.baseChange f r F =
        affineTraceLinearMap W r H ≫
          (affineTraceMap g r ≫ vectorIntegrationChart S r F V eS)
